info.run: County tax agent (Joseph E. Meyer & Associates, ILTaxSale.com) for the County Board
info.schedule: Annual sealed-bid auction of the parcels the county took by tax deed; the catalog is sold on iltaxsale.com and the results are posted free
info.note: Illinois sells tax liens at the annual tax sale (2.5-year redemption); these are the leftover parcels the county took by deed and resells at a sealed-bid auction.

auction.location: Lisa Roth, Treasurer Calhoun County Courthouse 301 S. County Road - P.O. Box 306 Hardin, IL 62047

auctions.label: Surplus tax deed auction (Real Estate - Sealed Bid)
auctions.note: Minimum bid 840.00 per parcel; catalog $5 on iltaxsale.com

parcels.desc: THIS PARCEL MAY HOME WITH ADDITIONS IF THE MOBILE HOME IS ASSESSED AS REAL ESTATE
